sn48.19:1.1: kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn48.19:2.1: Indriyasampanno indriyasampanno ti bhante vuccati || kittāvatā nu kho bhante indriyasampanno hotīti || || Idha bhikkhu bhikkhu saddhindriyam bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ || pe || paññindriyam bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ || || Ettāvatā kho bhikkhu bhikkhu indriyasampanno hotīti || ||
